about_the_game:
You hear footsteps upstairs. But you know the mansion is empty. At least... it should be. You hold your breath, gripping the tool in your hand, hoping it’s enough. Hoping you’re not too late. You keep your gun close, just in case.

“She knew something. She found something. And now... she’s gone.”

In Bound Beyond, you are sent to investigate the sudden disappearance of world-renowned archaeologist Asheley Mane. Her estate stands silent, filled with artifacts from lost civilizations—and something far more dangerous hiding in the walls. Step inside and uncover a mystery that reaches beyond the known world.

“There’s something here. Watching. Learning.”

Search the depths of Asheley’s mansion to uncover the truth. Solve complex puzzles, decode cryptic journals, and follow the trail she left behind. But beware—intelligent and unpredictable enemies are hunting you. They don’t simply chase. They study. They remember. And they adapt. 

Seek clues, evidence, and investigate what happened in the mansion. Face clever enemies that will adapt and hunt you. Explore a story-rich narrative and learn the fate of Ashley Mane. 

Can you survive long enough to discover what Asheley uncovered?

  • First-person psychological horror with survival elements

  • Explore a mysterious mansion filled with secrets, puzzles, and danger

  • Use tools and logic to solve environmental challenges

  • Evade clever enemies that respond to your behavior

  • Manage limited resources and your own sanity

  • Piece together the fate of Asheley Mane—and whoever claimed her

Play on the interactive map: open any door, closet, or drawer (or maybe this bookcase is movable too?) in search of clues and solve puzzles. 

Use tools from your detective arsenal: your gun, UV light, camera, flashlight, and, just in case, a lighter. Find handy tools on the map that help you progress. 

DISCLAIMER

This game is currently in development. All showcased gameplay, visuals, and features represent a work in progress and are subject to change. Final content may differ from what is shown.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features intense psychological horror elements and a tense, fear-driven atmosphere. It includes:
- Frightening imagery and sustained dread
- Encounters with supernatural entities
- Use of firearms in self-defense
- Themes of death and isolation

Occasional jump scares and disturbing audio/visual effects

While not graphically violent, the game is intended to unsettle and scare. Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 5500
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Best experience if the game is installed on SSD.

  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
